name: Asakura Saki
source:
Birthday: November 7, 1998 (Scorpio)
Birthstone: Topaz
Likes: Nature, animals, herself
Dislikes: Things that trample down nature, parents, fast vehicles
Special Skills: Studying, having a contrarian attitude, being affectionate to animals, swearing and abusive language
Family: Mother, father, grandmother

A rich girl who goes to the top-class K University, she is currently relaxing in her summer house during her exams break, which is right next to the lodge that [url=/c11470]Makoto[/url]'s group is staying at. A former classmate of [url=/c6707]Yuka[/url]'s from middle school, [spoiler]her class suspected that she destroyed The Magician's Portrait, a picture that Yuka drew. Since then, she's been slightly wary of other humans.

Ever since the incident, she hasn't shown her original self to anyone since then except for animals because she doesn't have to speak to them. However, this started to change when she came into contact with Makoto's group. She's resentful towards [url=/c6708]Haruka[/url], who is a clone, as a result of regret and fear she felt from when she was a child, when her mother forced her to injure a clone girl whom Saki had been friends with.[/spoiler]

(From PSP TIPS)
